skill.name: human-writer
skill.description: Edits existing drafts to remove repetitive machine-written patterns while preserving the writer's meaning, voice, formatting, and factual claims.

content.user_title: Polish Drafts While Preserving Your Voice
content.value_statement: Automated drafts can sound repetitive or overly polished and may lose the writer's original voice. This skill applies minimal editorial fixes while preserving meaning.
actual_capabilities: Edits existing drafts without adding new claims, examples, opinions, or arguments.
Detects listed machine-written patterns without assigning an authorship score.
Preserves visible voice traits, formatting, factual boundaries, and approved terminology.
Applies different editing depth for social posts, documentation, correspondence, and public copy.
Flags uncertain factual or stylistic choices instead of silently changing them.
Checks public-facing text for prohibited terms and long dashes with a bundled local script.
limitations: It does not generate new copy from scratch or expand an argument.
It does not verify facts beyond flagging an obvious possible error.
It cannot determine whether a person or model authored a text.
Its fixed pattern list may flag intentional style choices that require writer review.

use_cases.title: Refine a professional email
use_cases.description: Remove robotic phrasing and formatting artifacts while keeping the sender's directness, facts, and requested action unchanged.

use_cases.title: Review technical documentation
use_cases.description: Apply the full checklist while protecting precise claims, terminology, headings, and the document's established register.

use_cases.title: Audit a social draft
use_cases.description: Identify visible writing patterns without rewriting the post or making unsupported claims about authorship.

prompt_templates.title: Quick draft cleanup
prompt_templates.prompt: Edit this draft with the lightest possible touch. Remove clear machine-written patterns, preserve my meaning and formatting, and return only the corrected text.
prompt_templates.scenario: A short post, message, or email needs basic polishing.

prompt_templates.title: Detect patterns without editing
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this draft without rewriting it. Quote each detected pattern, name the checklist category, and suggest a brief fix without scoring authorship.
prompt_templates.scenario: The writer wants an inspection before deciding what to change.

prompt_templates.title: Preserve a defined voice
prompt_templates.prompt: Edit this draft using the supplied voice profile. Preserve its tone, rhythm, terminology, facts, and deliberate rough edges. Flag any uncertain change.
prompt_templates.scenario: A brand or named writer has explicit language rules.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare public documentation
prompt_templates.prompt: Apply the full documentation and public-copy checks to this file. Preserve technical meaning, run the bundled editorial checker, and summarize substantial change categories.
prompt_templates.scenario: A long public document needs a complete editorial pass.

output_examples.input: The app serves as a robust platform that streamlines daily reporting.
output_examples.output: The app is a platform that simplifies daily reporting.

output_examples.input: Audit this paragraph without editing: Distribution matters. This is the part most people skip.
output_examples.output: Faux-insight setup: "This is the part most people skip." Suggested fix: remove the setup and keep the concrete claim.

output_examples.input: Please polish this direct email: I need the revised figures by Thursday. Let me know if you would like more detail.
output_examples.output: I need the revised figures by Thursday.

best_practices: Provide the complete draft and identify its destination, such as email, documentation, or social media.
Supply a short voice profile when punctuation, terminology, or brand language must remain consistent.
Review flagged factual and stylistic choices because the skill intentionally leaves uncertain changes unresolved.
anti_patterns: Do not ask the skill to create a new article, argument, example, or factual claim.
Do not use detection results as proof that a model authored third-party text.
Do not request aggressive rewriting when preserving the writer's meaning and voice is required.

faq.question: Can this skill write a new draft from an outline?
faq.answer: No. It only edits existing text and does not add new claims, examples, or arguments.

faq.question: Does it change factual claims?
faq.answer: It flags an apparent factual error and asks before changing it. It does not perform a research or verification pass.

faq.question: Can it identify whether a model wrote the text?
faq.answer: No. Detect mode names visible patterns but does not assign authorship, probability, or confidence scores.

faq.question: Will it preserve my formatting?
faq.answer: Yes, unless the formatting itself matches a listed problem, such as stray Markdown in a plain-text destination.

faq.question: How does it handle a brand voice?
faq.answer: Provide a voice profile with tone, punctuation, approved terminology, and editing boundaries. The skill uses those rules during review.

faq.question: Does the bundled script send text anywhere?
faq.answer: No. The script reads the selected local text file, checks two prohibited patterns, and prints matching lines locally.
